capture.source: Original portfolio Ringwriter renderer in the existing local preview
capture.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA Corporation, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070/PCIe/SSE2, OpenGL ES 3.2)
capture.method: Deterministic original-scene export at 240 evenly spaced phases. Real hint already faded; rotational phase fixed; original shader six-octave zoom cycle. Capture-only scale1.2 and initial zoom0.38. Site source/deployment unchanged.

output.conversion: Original shader scene exported as PNG frames, Lanczos resize, global GIF palette. No crossfade, reverse playback, duplicated hold frames or model-generated imagery. GIF resizing/palette conversion is lossy.

validation.scope: Source/encoded cycle continuity and frame timing, not human approval or a physical-display performance measurement.

scope: Documentation GIFs only. Application/deployed image unchanged. Full export frames and previous banner backups retained locally.
